name: StockMate
shortDescription: Inventory management with immutable movement ledger, role permissions and labelled demand estimates.
features: Immutable movement ledger (receive/issue/adjust/reverse); corrections are reversing rows
Negative-stock guard refuses issues beyond on-hand (no silent backdating)
Reorder-level alerts; valuation at cost with book-estimate basis note
Demand projection labelled ESTIMATE with explicit assumptions
knownLimitations: Demo warehouse simulated; no FIFO lot tracking; no multi-location
Forecast is a flat average of the observed window — not a statistical model
